title: Referee & Referrer Each Get $10 off Per Month for 20 Months @ Amber Electric
body:
Deal: Referee & Referrer Each Get $10 off Per Month for 20 Months @ Amber Electric

[ndro777] Do people still make money on Amber? I left a while back cause we didn't get ROI on our battery. Now with Globird and consistently getting a small 50c credit. Used to be better before July.
[sprof] I still haven't had to pay a bill yet been with Amber almost 12 months
[FuRyZ] I mean that is not that impressive honestly. Anyone with a decently sized home battery can do that quite easily. I have done the same with Amber, Globird and more recently with CovaU. It is possible with many different plans.
The point of Amber is the ability to make good profits off your home battery installation so you can payback that battery investment in record time. In reality, that is extremely difficult if not impossible depending on which energy network you are located in.
[Tejas57] i left because the so called smart shift battery controller was rubbish and i needed to baby it. i switched to origin where i get 22kw/h feed in between 4 and 9 pm
[FuRyZ] I left because it was far too difficult to make any appreaciable amount of money on Amber.
I was micro managing my exports all day, staring at the app looking at 5min export prices like a crazy person. Meanwhile my solar was just about permanently curtailed. I was going around turning off devices, load shifting all the time. It was miserable honestly.
Things may be different for those in a network with more price spikes. But the SEQ Energex network is far too stable and the wholesale pricing is far too low for Amber to make sense here.
I switched to Globird Zerohero and immediately I have 4 times more profit in the first month with absolutely zero micromanagement. It was so much better in every single way.
[FuRyZ] Also dont believe a single thing that Amber's marketing says or their dodgy online calculator.
When I signed up, their calculator estimated that I should be making 10 times more profit what I ended up making in a single month.
[sphinxy] 13 months in and yes, I also haven't had to pay yet and still just under $200 in credit.
Wanting more spikes though 😏
[sprof] Maybe coming I noticed a couple last few days including this morning of $1 yes not great but something
[bajillionaire] Not in QLD. The grid is too stable so no opportunities to discharge into price spikes (there are no spikes). I'm with Globird too. I make a little credit consistently and don't have to micromanage.
[Aguynamedlance] I emailed and got 12 months of FIT and costs for my location. I can make more with AGL in 12 days then I would have with amber over the 12 months.
[Hvrd] In adelaide had a price spike this morning and made $2.73 for 3.2kwh. Smartshift is ok, doesent take advantage of low prices and fill battery to 100% unless its free import, export has been good
